answer: The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the fable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
